persuasion is kept inside πείθεις's unit as the word glossing that lexeme; marking it added under rule 103 and heading the unit on wouldest remains defensible. The ASV's margin (In a little time) construes ἐν ὀλίγῳ temporally, which would not change the token pairings.

variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'And Agrippa said unto Paul' has a verb of speaking, but the base reading's ellipsis obliges the translator to supply one; the render carries no italic marking, so the English does not report whether ephe stood.
ASV reads 'thou wouldest fain make me a Christian' — a transitive 'make' rendering poiesai; r01's genesthai is intransitive 'become' and would give 'that I become a Christian'.

variant_decisions.evidence: Pure transposition of axion; English idiom requires 'worthy' before both genitives ('nothing worthy of death or of bonds') under either Greek order.
ASV 'This man doeth nothing worthy of death' shows no separate reflex of the indefinite ti alongside ouden.

review_notes: εἰ μή is split rather than treated as one noncompositional unit because the ASV writes two separate English words, if and not, in different places (rule 39's test).
unto at t019 is kept with the verb under rule 106's accusative arm; giving it to Καίσαρα would treat an accusative as if it had a case for English to realize.
